title: Agent Slayer tool object-input bindings
description: Provider-owned declarations connecting exact tool input locations to IDs or stable references consumed from runtime bindings conforming to https://agent-slayer.local/schemas/first-class-object-binding.v1.schema.json.
$comment: Consumer contract in the Agent Slayer first-class object identity protocol suite.

objectType.description: Must equal the type of the canonical first-class object binding consumed at this input path.

value.description: Selects objects[].id or objects[].ref from the matching canonical first-class object binding.
